name: 45694 · Wheelersburg, OH
findings: ZIP 45694 (Wheelersburg) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45694 (Wheelersburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45694 (Wheelersburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
